test_vmap: test the functorch vmap function that applies a function over batched inputs with configurable in_dims and out_dims
test_grad: test the functorch grad function that computes gradients of a function with respect to specified argument indices
test_vjp: test the functorch vjp function that computes vector-Jacobian products for a given function and primal inputs
test_jacrev: test the functorch jacrev function that computes Jacobians using reverse-mode differentiation
test_make_functional: test the functorch make_functional function that converts a PyTorch module into a functional form with explicit parameters
